name: National CSR Awards
benefit: > The awardees are presented with a trophy and scroll and runner ups with a medal and scroll.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a company registered under the Companies Act, 1956 or 2013 and must comply with Section 135 of the Companies Act, 2013. 1. The CSR project and related expenditure should pertain to the specified financial years. 1. The impact of the CSR project/programme should be demonstrated based on the required reporting period as per submitted details.
